chunks: And Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Matt al-Jawhari narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, from ‘Ali ibn Ismā‘īl, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Amr, from Abān, from ‘Abd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ‘Abdillāh, who said:
I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him), ‘How should I place my hand on the graves of the believers?’ He faced the Qiblah, pointed toward the earth with his hand, and then placed his hand on it.
ai.seo_question: What is the correct physical posture and gesture when visiting the graves of believers according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) demonstrates the physical etiquette of Ziyārah by facing the Qiblah and placing his hand on the earth, establishing a direct spiritual link between the visitor, the deceased, and the Divine direction. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on tangible reverence and the belief that the graves of the righteous remain connected to the spiritual realm, serving as a means of seeking blessings (barakah) through proper orientation and touch.
